snippet.title: PES 2009 (PC) - Gameplay
snippet.description:
Pro Evolution Soccer 2009 (PES 2009, known as World Soccer: Winning Eleven 2009 in Korea and Japan) is a football video game in the Pro Evolution Soccer series, which was made by Konami. It is also the exclusive licensed game of the UEFA Champions League.

▌PC Gameplays Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLXEHhSievieFw3PRaPmrVQ4mTjr4BMRE0
